text:
Pro: Modernly equipped clinic, beautiful design. There is a mini children's playground. Toilet for children. Friendly staff.
Cons:
*Chaotic atmosphere. My baby is 1 year and 3 months old. He had a temperature of about 38 degrees. He was very sensitive and emotional this day. During the tests, each nurse came up every 3 minutes, looked into the pants, and looked to see if the child had peed. It was as if they were rushing him. Which was very annoying for a child who was very sick. The doctor was also sarcastically surprised : How come you haven’t peed yet? We were in no hurry, but the team was in a hurry, since the laboratory for checking the debt analyzes was soon to close. It seems to me that the one-year-old child did not really want to pee in such a chaotic atmosphere, since he could not relax due to the fact that the nurses were bothering him every 3 minutes.
*Non-Professionalism of doctors. That day, my child only had a fever; other symptoms had not yet appeared. The doctor suggested that our baby take the  urine and blood test from a vein in order to make a diagnosis. I agreed, but later I regretted it. I have already described the issue of urine test above. But taking a blood test is definitely a psychologically traumatic action. Everything happened so quickly that I didn’t even have time to mentally prepare my child for the blood test from a vein. I don't think this should have been done at all. Watching your one-year-old baby cry, be afraid and horrified by the whole process.

After receiving a laboratory blood report, the doctor revealed only a viral infection. However, she did not say what kind of viral infection it was. We were not given any medications except ibuprofen in case of high fever. Although we did not need this medicine, as we used paracetamol.
As a result, we paid more than 1,600 TB, for the blood test, for the appointment and care ? of a doctor and nurses, for an unclear diagnosis and unnecessary medicine.

After such service, where the direction is to get more money from clients and not give anything in return, I don’t want to go back and recommend such a clinic.

On a professional note, our baby showed more symptoms the next day. We went to another simple clinic with a professional doctor and within 15 minutes received a clear diagnosis with medications. No blood and urine test have been required, just professionalism of this doctor. We only paid 300 TB for everything. Three days later our child recovered. And of course, I will come back here in case if my baby is sick. Bcz of the professionalism and care of the doctor.

restaurant_name: DD kids clinic Siracha ดีดี คิดส์ คลินิก ศรีราชา
text:
The clinic was clean, and the staff were polite. However, my overall experience was disappointing.

The consultation fee and medication costs were much higher than I expected. We visited because my child had symptoms of gastroenteritis, but I did not feel confident that the diagnosis was clear. Several medications were prescribed, and during the visit we also ended up purchasing formula milk. At the time, we were worried about our child, so we paid without questioning it. Looking back, however, the total cost felt excessive and unreasonable. I felt like I was simply paying for everything that was presented to me without fully understanding whether it was all necessary.

In my personal opinion, I also felt that the doctor did not fully understand or identify my child's condition based on the symptoms and examination.

The following day, we visited another hospital. My child was examined again and prescribed medication, but the overall medical cost was much more reasonable. More importantly, the doctor explained my child's condition and treatment plan in a clear and easy-to-understand way, which gave us much greater confidence and peace of mind as parents.

This review reflects only my personal experience. I hope the clinic can improve communication by providing clearer explanations about the diagnosis, treatment plan, and expected costs before parents make decisions.

Thank you
